hooks.text: 把卡牌首尾相连铺成吞噬路径，每条不可逆连接都要付代价
hooks.excerpt: Cards are not tools, But the fragments and extensions of your will; Paths are not choices, but corridors the world is compelled to surrender. At the cost of every irrevocable bond,
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 数百张卡轮换组合，在资源、构筑、谜题和收集中平衡威胁
hooks.excerpt: With hundreds of cards at your disposal, craft shifting combinations and discover endless playstyles. Explore four distinct regions. Balance resource management, deck-building, puzzles, and card collection to overcome ever-evolving threats.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 干预人类命运并与7名关键角色结缘，开启隐藏故事与多结局
hooks.excerpt: Encounter a diverse cast of humans. Choose to remain a silent observer or intervene in their lives. Build bonds with up to 7 key characters to unlock hidden stories and multiple endings.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
